newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to study local business tax reform.
newsitem.headline: France to study local business tax reform.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Thursday it was setting up a working group to consider a reform of local business taxes and come up with a report before the end of the year.
Successive governments have repeatedly pledged to reform the "taxe professionalle", a tax charged by local authorities on businesses in their area, but have been unable to do so.
The finance ministry said the working group, including representatives from businesses and local and national politicians, would meet first on April 22.
